verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents one batch limit (up to 100 requests per Batch API call). It also makes one queue-related claim: enterprise dedicated GPUs mean renders "never queue behind anyone." There is no documentation of concurrency limits or of how standard-tier queues behave, so a production pipeline cannot be planned from this evidence. Missing for 10: documented concurrent-render limits per plan, standard-tier queue behavior and ordering, rate-limit and throttling rules, and expected render latency under load.

support.subject: As a developer, concurrency limits and queue behavior for batch rendering are documented, so I can plan a production pipeline

citations.quote: Batch APIs — up to 100 requests per call, webhooks included
Dedicated GPUs with guaranteed throughput. Your renders never queue behind anyone.
